messages:
Ethan: hey - first week here. quick confusion: which key should I use for short PoCs and demos — sandbox key or hosted org key? also curious about IP allowlisting and whether that affects 429s.
Nora: welcome Ethan! sandbox = easiest (auto-provisioned) but very constrained. hosted (org) keys are tied to your org/account and have bigger quotas. IP allowlisting is unrelated to rate limits; it just restricts which client IPs can use a key.
Ethan: ah ok. I have a laptop behind a corp VPN that rotates IPs which is why i asked. if IPs change frequently, is hosted key still okay?
DevEx: hosted keys with allowlist are fine if you add the VPN egress IPs. if IPs rotate unpredictably, don't enable allowlist for demos. for prod, use a proxy or VPN with stable egress and then allowlist that.
Sam: extra note: we issue short-lived ephemeral tokens for CI/workflows instead of embedding long-lived hosted keys in repos. ephemeral tokens won't hit allowlist unless the proxy IPs are stable.
Ethan: thanks. on quotas — i'm seeing intermittent 429s when opening 4 browser tabs streaming a small chat each. what buckets could that be?
Claire: common buckets: concurrent connections, requests/sec, and tokens/min. sandbox often has low concurrent-stream caps (2-4). hosted varies by plan. 4 tabs could easily exceed a concurrent-stream limit on sandbox.
Ethan: how can i tell from the response which bucket I hit?
Nora: check headers & error body. sample response we return:
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
x-rw-rate-limit-remaining: 0
x-rw-rate-limit-reset: 1855554360
x-rw-retry-after: 1.6
{ "error":"rate_limited","reason":"concurrent_streams" }
```
Sam: if "reason" is tokens/min you'll see a tokens hint. also look for x-rw-embed-* headers for embeddings-specific quotas.
Ethan: can I request a temporary bump for a demo? who do I ping and what's the usual turnaround?
DevEx: ping #devex with your name, email, project, and time window. for sandbox we can often enable a 24-48h boost the same day. for hosted quota increases, owners should open a Console quota request; that takes longer (1-3 business days).
InfraBot: ticket DX-309 created for Ethan (sandbox boost requested, 24h).
Ethan: great. any quick best-practices to avoid hitting limits in demos?
Claire: yes — reuse a single streaming connection and multiplex logical conversations, trim prompt prefixes, limit max_tokens, and add simple retry/backoff on 429s (exp backoff with jitter). For browser demos consider showing one live stream and simulate others with prerecorded content to reduce load.
Sam: also consider using a dedicated sandbox key for your demo session vs your personal key so we can monitor and revoke if needed.
Ethan: perfect. i'll file the devex request and try multiplexing. thanks everyone! :party_popper:
